newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two young French Nirvana fans commit suicide.
newsitem.headline: Two young French Nirvana fans commit suicide.

text.p: Two French schoolgirls who were fans of the rock band Nirvana shot themselves in the head in a copycat suicide modelled on the 1994 death of lead singer Kurt Cobain, a public prosecutor said on Thursday.

The girls, Aurelie and Valentine, aged 13 and 12, left a note saying they were in love with the U.S. grunge rock group's leader before shooting themselves on Wednesday in Somain, northern France, with a pistol owned by one of their fathers.
Cobain died in 1994 from a shotgun blast to the head in his mansion on the shores of Lake Washington.
"The girls had written notes which left no doubt about their intentions. Schoolfriends tried to talk them out of it without success," public prosecutor Jean-Marie Descamps told reporters.
"No adult was aware. This seems to have been a sort of adolescent secret," he said.
"There seems to have been a sort of adoration, of veneration for members of Nirvana and especially of the singer who committed suicide," he added.
